messages.en:
{07 16 00}I've only caught a bunch
of puny dweeb fish so
far, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma olen seni püüdnud vaid
hunniku pisikesi nõrku
kalu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 03 00}Bahaha!{01 00 00 0a 00} I caught that bug
ages ago! That has GOT to
be embarrassing for you!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}What?{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}We're supposed to be{01 00 00 05 00}
catching fish? 
{07 06 00}Wait right here. I'll go
wrestle me one right outta
the water, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 03 00}Bahahaa!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma püüdsin selle
putuka ammu ära! See peab
sulle küll piinlik olema!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}Mida?{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}Me peaksime hoopis{01 00 00 05 00}
kalu püüdma? 
{07 06 00}Oota siin. Ma lähen maadlen
ühe otse veest
välja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Hook me up with any extra
fish you catch! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}
and I are in a competition!
{07 02 00}HEY! Wait a dang second,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} That's you!!!{01 01 00}

{07 15 00}You{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. I'll be watchin'
you, punk!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Anna mulle kõik ülejäänud
kalad, mis püüad! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}
ja mina võistleme!
{07 02 00}HEI! Oota pagana sekund,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} See oled sina!!!{01 01 00}

{07 15 00}Sina{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Ma jälgin
